role: AI Automation Engineer - MERN Stack and LLM Integrations
fit_line: An applied seat building "OpenAI, Claude and Gemini API integration", "RAG pipelines" and "AI agents" on JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js and Node.js, which is what Hussain ships and does daily with AI coding assistants.
ai_in_job: "OpenAI, Claude and Gemini API integration"; "Git, GitHub and AI coding assistants". Building with LLMs and using AI coding assistants is the job itself.

screening_answers.question: Why are you interested in this role?
screening_answers.answer: The role is what I already build: LLM API integrations, function calling, RAG, webhooks and agents on a JavaScript/TypeScript, React and Node stack, with AI coding assistants as a normal part of the work. I have 3 years of professional full-stack experience and have shipped LLM products such as site-to-agent (hybrid BM25 + pgvector RAG with an eval harness) and ai-lead-receptionist (a Claude agent behind Twilio webhooks). I would like to do this full time on AI product development.

screening_answers.question: Describe your experience with LLM APIs, function calling and structured JSON outputs.
screening_answers.answer: I work with the Claude and Gemini APIs. TripSync uses Gemini structured outputs to return three AI-generated trip packages per request, with Supabase Edge Functions behind it. multi-agent-research-crew uses Claude with tool use on a custom DAG orchestrator with retries, timeouts, token budgets and claim-level citation checking. I hold the Claude Certified Developer – Foundations (CCDV-F) certificate from Anthropic. I have not used the OpenAI API directly, but I built an OpenAI-compatible streaming API in nanoserve, so the protocol is familiar.

screening_answers.question: Tell us about a RAG or AI agent project you are proud of.
screening_answers.answer: site-to-agent (github.com/huss2003/site-to-agent) turns any website into a grounded chat agent: a crawler, hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval (pgvector) fused with RRF, cited answers, SSRF-hardened fetching and an eval harness to measure answer quality. I am proud of it because it is built with evals and guardrails, not just a demo. Next.js, TypeScript.

screening_answers.question: Do you have experience with MongoDB and the MERN stack?
screening_answers.answer: I work daily in JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Node.js and have shipped REST APIs and webhooks. My database experience is PostgreSQL, Supabase and SQLite rather than MongoDB, so I have not used MongoDB in production. Document-model schema work is a short step from there and I am happy to show that quickly.

screening_answers.question: Have you used n8n, Make or similar workflow automation tools?
screening_answers.answer: I have built workflow automation in code: HMAC-signed webhooks, CRM integrations (HubSpot) and Twilio SMS flows in ai-lead-receptionist. I have not used n8n or Make yet. I can rebuild one of those flows in n8n as a demo before an interview.

screening_answers.question: What is your expected salary?
screening_answers.answer: I am targeting INR 30,000 per month or more. I am flexible on structure; what matters is the total package and the work.

screening_answers.question: What is your current CTC?
screening_answers.answer: [CONFIRM: current CTC at the previous employer, or whether you prefer to say it is not applicable / decline to share]

screening_answers.question: What is your notice period / when can you join?
screening_answers.answer: Immediate. My previous role ended in September 2026.

screening_answers.question: Where are you located, and are you comfortable working remotely?
screening_answers.answer: I am based in Pune, India (IST, UTC+05:30) and I am comfortable working fully remote. I worked remotely for a US-based medical-device company for over 3 years. [CONFIRM: that this role's remote work is open to a Pune-based candidate, since the listing shows Gurugram]

paragraphs: I am applying for the AI Automation Engineer - MERN Stack and LLM Integrations role. I am a software developer turned AI engineer with 3 years of professional full-stack experience at a US-based medical-device company, where I built web applications, a CRM and internal AI agents. I use Claude Code every day and hold the Claude Certified Developer – Foundations certificate from Anthropic.

Your posting asks for LLM API integration, function calling, RAG and AI agents on JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js and Node.js. site-to-agent (github.com/huss2003/site-to-agent) is a grounded chat agent with hybrid BM25 + pgvector retrieval, cited answers and an eval harness. ai-lead-receptionist (github.com/huss2003/ai-lead-receptionist) is a Claude agent behind Twilio webhooks that qualifies leads and books jobs. TripSync uses Gemini structured outputs to return JSON packages, and multi-agent-research-crew adds retries, timeouts and token budgets to Claude agents.

To be straightforward, my databases have been PostgreSQL, Supabase and SQLite rather than MongoDB, and I have built webhook automations in code rather than in n8n or Make. I pick tools up quickly and can model an n8n flow as a demo. I am based in Pune, can join immediately, and my portfolio is at hussain-singapuri.vercel.app. Thank you for your time.
